[P2] Preserve diagnostics from nonfatal setup wrappers

The new normalization transfers wrapper diagnostics only when the selected cause is fatal. If the second `Context.getAwsRequestId()` call throws `CompletionException(X)` with nonfatal cause `X` and suppressed error `D`, successful cleanup now leaves the caller with only `X`; `D` becomes unreachable. The base revision propagated the setup wrapper intact. Preserve diagnostics from discarded nonfatal completion wrappers as well, excluding aliases that create cycles, and extend `OwnedExecutorSetupFailureTest` with this case.
